verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents syncing Authenticator verification codes with the Password Manager vault, which keeps the apps synchronized with any codes you add or edit. It also documents exporting vault data as a backup or to transfer it to a new vault, and an authenticator import/export path. Together these give a documented way to keep tokens off a single phone, but no evidence shows an explicit lost-phone, new-device restore walkthrough. missing for 10: explicit documented new-device token restoration flow, guidance for recovering after losing the device, independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful restore.

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device

citations.quote: Connect Authenticator with Password Manager to sync your verification codes. Once activated, the Bitwarden apps stay synchronized with any codes you add or edit
Export your vault data, including logins and notes, to back up important information or transfer to a new Bitwarden vault.
